mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may reduce ferrous iron absorption through increased gastrointestinal transit and altered pH; ferrous sulfate may reduce eslicarbazepine levels through chelation and reduced bioavailability.
action: Separate administration by 2+ hours and monitor for reduced eslicarbazepine efficacy; consider measuring eslicarbazepine levels if seizure control is inadequate.
